command.name: Breath of Fire
verbatim: Rounds 2, 5, 8: Deal Fire Damage to 2 Enemies within adjacency (Damage Rate: +100%), increased to +150% against Panic.
At 10 Stars: deal Fire Damage to one Enemy in any lane (+60%) with 40% Burn chance, then a different Enemy (+30%) with 20% Burn chance.

vanguard.name: Hunter's Wrath
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Fire Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Strength and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Ensnare
habits.verbatim: Round 1: Reduce Instinct and Initiative by -18% (enhanced by Intelligence) of 2 Enemies within adjacency for 3 round(s).

habits.name: Blazing Onslaught
habits.verbatim: Start of Round 1: Increase Fire Damage Received of 1 Enemy in any lane (prioritizes the Left Flank) and Physical Damage Received (excluding Basic Attacks) of 1 Enemy in any lane (prioritizes the Right Flank) by +15% for 3 round(s).

habits.name: Scorched Earth
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 10% chance to afflict Vulnerable (+15%) on 2 Enemies within adjacency for 2 round(s). This chance is doubled (20%) against targets afflicted with Panic.

habits.name: Dragon's Intellect
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce your Damage Received by -5% and increase your Intelligence by +8.5% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Blazing Conductor
habits.verbatim: Breath of Fire gains: Rounds 2, 5, 8: Deal Fire Damage to 1 Enemy in any lane (Damage Rate: +60%) and there is a 40% chance to afflict the target with Burn for 2 round(s). Then deal Fire Damage to a different Enemy in any lane (Damage Rate: +30%) and there is a 20% chance to afflict the target with Burn for 2 round(s).
